name: @arious-meet/mcp
description: Typed TypeScript client for the Arious Meet MCP server (Node 18+, Deno, Bun: fetch only).

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/client.test.js dist-test/test/live.test.js
scripts.test:live: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-name-pattern=live dist-test/test/live.test.js
